examples.en: Water after exercise tastes like heaven.

examples.ko: 소문난 식당이라 그런지 음식이 그야말로 꿀맛이었어요.
examples.en: Maybe because it's a famous restaurant, the food was absolutely delicious.

examples.ko: 배고플 때 먹는 라면은 정말 꿀맛이죠?
examples.en: Ramen when you're hungry is really delicious, right?
Lunch after working feels so good.
The watermelon is sweet, so it tastes amazing.
On a tiring day, a nap feels like pure bliss.

explain: 실제 꿀 맛보다는 '아주 맛있다'는 칭찬으로 많이 써요. 배고플 때나 힘든 일을 한 뒤에 먹는 음식에 잘 어울려요. 잠에는 비슷하게 '꿀잠'이라는 말을 써요.
explain_en: It is used far more as praise meaning 'really delicious' than for actual honey. It suits food eaten when you are hungry or after hard work. For sleep, there is the similar word '꿀잠'.

examples.en: Pickled radish goes into kimbap.

examples.ko: 자장면을 시키면 단무지하고 양파가 같이 와요.
examples.en: If you order jajangmyeon, pickled radish and onions come with it.
I eat kimbap without the pickled radish.

examples.ko: 단무지 좀 더 주실 수 있어요?
examples.en: Could you give me a bit more pickled radish?
Pickled radish is yellow, so it stands out.
Snack bars serve pickled radish as a side dish.

explain: 자장면, 김밥, 분식집에서 빠지지 않는 반찬이에요. 달고 새콤해서 기름진 음식과 잘 어울려요.
explain_en: It is a side dish that always shows up with jajangmyeon, kimbap and at snack bars. Its sweet and sour taste goes well with greasy food.

examples.ko: 탕수육 소스가 새콤달콤해서 계속 먹게 돼요.
examples.en: The sweet and sour pork sauce is so tasty that I keep eating.
I want to eat sweet and sour spicy noodles.
This strawberry jam is sweet and tangy and smells good too.
I think I made the sauce too sweet and sour.
My mom made me a sweet and sour cucumber salad.
The tangerines are sweeter and tangier than expected, so the kids like them.

explain: '새콤'은 기분 좋은 가벼운 신맛이라서 좋은 맛을 말할 때 써요. 상해서 시큼한 맛과는 느낌이 달라요. 과일, 소스, 무침처럼 맛있는 음식에 잘 어울려요.
explain_en: '새콤' is a light, pleasant sourness, so it is used for tastes people enjoy. It feels different from the sharp sourness of food that has gone off. It fits tasty things like fruit, sauces and seasoned side dishes.

examples.en: We dip raw fish in chogochujang.
I bought gochujang and vinegar to make chogochujang.
Could I have some more chogochujang?
We serve blanched squid with chogochujang.
The chogochujang was too sour, so I added sugar.
Adding chogochujang to spicy noodles makes them tangy.

explain: 주로 회나 데친 해산물에 찍어 먹는 새콤달콤한 소스예요. 고기를 쌈에 싸 먹을 때 쓰는 '쌈장'과는 쓰임이 달라요.
explain_en: It is a sweet-and-sour dipping sauce used mainly for raw fish and blanched seafood. It is used differently from '쌈장', which goes with meat wraps.

examples.ko: 한국식 치킨은 바삭한 튀김옷과 달콤한 양념이 특징이에요.
examples.en: Korean fried chicken is known for its crispy batter and sweet sauce.
I coat the shrimp in batter and fry it in oil.
If the batter is too thick, it tastes greasy.
You make the batter by mixing the flour into cold water.

examples.ko: 튀김옷 때문에 고기 맛이 잘 안 느껴져요.
examples.en: Because of the batter, I can't taste the meat well.

examples.ko: 튀김옷에 빵가루를 한 번 더 묻혀 보세요.
examples.en: Try coating it with breadcrumbs one more time over the batter.

explain: 음식에 옷을 입히는 것처럼 반죽을 묻힌다고 봐서 '튀김옷을 입히다'라고 말해요. '옷'이 들어간 말이지만 먹을 수 있는 부분이에요.
explain_en: Because coating the food is likened to dressing it, you say '튀김옷을 입히다'. Although it contains the word 'clothes' (옷), it is the edible coating.

examples.en: I dip green peppers in soybean paste and eat them.
This green pepper is much hotter than I thought.
I bought a bag of green peppers at the market.
I stir-fried green peppers together with anchovies.
Green peppers are green because they are not ripe yet.

examples.ko: 쌈장이랑 풋고추만 있어도 밥 한 그릇이 뚝딱이에요.
examples.en: With just ssamjang and green peppers, I can finish a bowl of rice in no time.

explain: '풋-'은 덜 익었다는 뜻이라서 빨갛게 익은 고추와 구별할 때 써요. 일상에서는 그냥 '고추'라고도 많이 말해요.
explain_en: The prefix '풋-' means not fully ripe, so the word is used to tell these apart from red, ripened peppers. In daily life people also often just say '고추'.

examples.en: Bell peppers are green and not spicy.

examples.ko: 이 피자에 피망을 더 올려 주세요.
examples.en: Please put more bell pepper on this pizza.

examples.ko: 우리 아이는 피망을 쓰다고 안 먹어요.
examples.en: My child won't eat bell pepper because it tastes bitter.
I chopped the bell pepper small and stir-fried it.

examples.ko: 초록색보다 빨간색 피망이 훨씬 더 달아요.
examples.en: Red bell peppers are much sweeter than green ones.

examples.ko: 피망 속 씨를 빼고 깨끗이 씻으세요.
examples.en: Remove the seeds inside the bell pepper and wash it well.

explain: 한국에서 매운 고추는 '고추'나 '청양고추'라고 하고, 맵지 않은 채소는 '피망'이라고 해서 서로 달라요. 비슷하게 생긴 '파프리카'는 색이 다양하고 더 달고 두꺼워서 샐러드에 생으로 많이 먹어요. 피망은 초록색이고 약간 쌉쌀해서 볶음 요리에 많이 넣어요.
explain_en: In Korea hot peppers are called 고추 or 청양고추, while the mild vegetable is 피망, so they are different things. The similar-looking 파프리카 comes in many colors and is sweeter and thicker, often eaten raw in salads. 피망 is green and slightly bitter, and is often used in stir-fries.

examples.en: In winter I buy steamed buns at the convenience store.
There is red bean paste inside the steamed bun.
The steamed bun just came out and is hot, so be careful.

examples.ko: 호빵은 야채와 단팥 중에 뭐 먹을래요?
examples.en: Which kind of steamed bun will you have, vegetable or red bean?
My younger sibling and I split the steamed bun in half.
I heat frozen steamed buns in the microwave before eating them.

explain: '찐빵'과 비슷한 간식인데, 호빵은 겨울에 편의점이나 마트 찜기에서 파는 따뜻한 빵이라는 느낌이 강해요. 그래서 여름보다 겨울에 훨씬 자주 들려요. 속은 팥, 야채, 피자 맛 등이 있어요.
explain_en: It is close to 'jjinppang', but 'hoppang' feels like the hot bun sold from a steamer at convenience stores and supermarkets in winter. You hear it far more in winter than in summer. Fillings include red bean, vegetable and pizza flavor.
